title: Complete proposed build provenance v3; exact26 dependency contract; later actual evidence required
$comment: Jointly normative with protocol.md v3.0.0 and consumer-contract.md v3.0.0. No actual build instance or execution authorization supplied. Objects are strict; cross-field reference, path and actual-evidence rules are mandatory in addition to schema shape. Complete protocol3 forward design; source lock26, canonical23, supplier22, runtime8 and source33 are distinct. No execution authority.

items.$comment: directory => archiveId/memberName null and path is actual bundle file; PYZ/CArchive => closed archiveId and exact inventory member; path is actual containing ordinary bundle file. bytes/sha256 identify the mapped file or raw member respectively.
